claims: Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
Ryan Coogler's Sinners garnered 16 nominations, the most in Academy history.
The 10 Best Picture nominees included Sinners, One Battle After Another, Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, and Train Dreams.
One Battle After Another secured the top prize.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.
The 2026 ceremony took place on March 15, 2026.
The 2026 ceremony was hosted by Conan O'Brien.
The 2026 ceremony took place at the Fox News website.
